dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know what the Fatui are shipping?

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: Shh... Don't let the captain overhear you! He keeps drumming into us the importance of keeping shtum when it comes to customers' affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: To tell you the truth, I'd like to know myself. But those boxes... They're packed in tighter than fish in a trawler's hold. There's no way anyone's seeing into them...
